# Question

`acf_example_genes.R` pooled every read of the 15 example genes and found that the three
pausing / expression groups differ in their m6A autocorrelation from TSS +50 to +2500 bp.
Here each gene's reads are split by allele at a heterozygous SNP, as in
`06_autocorrelation.Rmd`, and the same figures and tests are repeated on the REF reads and
on the ALT reads separately. If the group differences are a property of the genes, both
allele read sets should show them.

REF and ALT are defined by the reference genome, not by pausing: no allele-specific pausing
is measured in these samples. The split therefore checks that the result replicates in two
independent haplotype read sets per gene; it does not remove gene-level confounding.

```{r inputs}
FT_DIR  <- "/project/spott/1_Shared_projects/LCL_Fiber_seq/FIRE/results"
PHASING <- "/project/spott/1_Shared_projects/LCL_Fiber_seq/preprocess_final_merged_samples"
SAMPLES <- "/project/spott/1_Shared_projects/LCL_Fiber_seq/Data/LCL_sample_metatable_merged_samples_31samples.csv"
GROUPS  <- c("non-paused, high", "paused, high", "paused, moderate")
ALLELES <- c("REF", "ALT")

# the genes, groups and windows of the pooled run
genes <- fread(file.path(PROJECT, "LCL_project/pausing/acf_tss_downstream/tables/genes.tsv"))
stopifnot(nrow(genes) == 15L, setequal(genes$group, GROUPS),
          genes[, all(ifelse(strand == "+", analysis_start - tss, tss - analysis_end) == 50L)],
          genes[, all(analysis_end - analysis_start + 1L == 2451L)])

# phased samples, with the VCF column of each sample's cell line
samples <- as.data.frame(fread(SAMPLES)[with_genotype == "Yes"])
samples$vcf_column <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i)
  lcl_vcf_sample_column(samples$phased_vcf_file[i], samples$cell_line[i]), integer(1))
stopifnot(!anyNA(samples$vcf_column))
```

# Focal SNP per gene

For each gene, the focal SNP is the biallelic SNV inside its window that is phased
heterozygous (`0|1` or `1|0` with a phase set) in the most of the
`r nrow(samples)` phased samples; ties go to the SNV nearest the TSS. Only those
heterozygous samples contribute reads.

```{r focal-snps}
#' Phased heterozygous biallelic SNVs in one gene's window, one row per sample carrying one.
window_het_snvs <- function(g) {
  query <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(g$chrom, IRanges::IRanges(g$analysis_start, g$analysis_end))
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
    lines <- Rsamtools::scanTabix(Rsamtools::TabixFile(samples$phased_vcf_file[i]), param = query)[[1]]
    rbindlist(lapply(strsplit(lines, "\t", fixed = TRUE), function(x) {
      if (nchar(x[4]) != 1L || nchar(x[5]) != 1L) return(NULL)
      keys   <- strsplit(x[9], ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      values <- strsplit(x[samples$vcf_column[i]], ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      gt <- values[match("GT", keys)]; ps <- values[match("PS", keys)]
      if (!isTRUE(gt %in% c("0|1", "1|0")) || is.na(ps) || ps == ".") return(NULL)
      data.table(pos = as.integer(x[2]), id = x[3], ref = x[4], alt = x[5],
                 sample_name = samples$sample_name[i])
    }))
  }))
}

focal <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i]
  snvs <- window_het_snvs(g)[, .(n_het_samples = .N,
                                 contributing_samples = paste(sample_name, collapse = ",")),
                             by = .(pos, id, ref, alt)]
  snvs[, tss_distance_bp := abs(pos - g$tss)]
  setorder(snvs, -n_het_samples, tss_distance_bp)
  data.table(gene_name = g$gene_name, group = g$group, n_snvs_in_window = nrow(snvs), snvs[1])
}))
focal[, focal_snp := ifelse(id == ".", paste0(genes$chrom, ":", pos), id)]
fwrite(focal, file.path(out, "tables", "focal_snps.tsv"), sep = "\t")
focal[, .(group, gene_name, focal_snp, pos, ref, alt, n_het_samples, tss_distance_bp, n_snvs_in_window)]
```

# Reads and autocorrelation by allele

Reads come from `lcl_build_phased_m6a_input()`: full-span reads with at least one m6A call
in the window from the heterozygous samples, kept only when their HiPhase haplotag and the
sample's phased genotype at the focal SNP resolve the allele. The parent
`annotate_alleles()` turns haplotag + genotype into REF / ALT, `autocorrelations()` gives
the per-read ACF, and `summarize()` gives each allele's mean curve and 140-250 bp repeat
peak, exactly as for the pooled genes.

```{r allele-acf}
per_gene <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(genes)), function(i) {
  g <- genes[i]; f <- focal[i]
  region <- data.frame(region_id = g$gene_name, chr = g$chrom, start = g$analysis_start - 1L,
                       end = g$analysis_end, analysis_start = g$analysis_start,
                       analysis_end = g$analysis_end, focal_pos = f$pos, focal_snp = f$focal_snp,
                       ref = f$ref, alt = f$alt, contributing_samples = f$contributing_samples)
  dat <- lcl_build_phased_m6a_input(region, samples, FT_DIR, PHASING)
  reads <- annotate_alleles(dat$read_meta, pd$Series(as.list(region)), samples)
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(dat$met_mat), reads$row_id))
  dense <- as.matrix(dat$met_mat)
  storage.mode(dense) <- "integer"
  res   <- autocorrelations(dense)
  valid <- as.logical(res[[2]])
  records <- data.frame(region_id = g$gene_name, RID = reads$row_id[valid],
                        sample_name = reads$sample_name[valid],
                        m6a_call_fraction = rowMeans(dense)[valid],
                        cluster = match(reads$allele_group[valid], ALLELES), status = "clustered")
  s <- summarize(res[[1]][valid, , drop = FALSE], records)
  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(s[[2]]$cluster), 1:2))
  list(curves = as.data.table(s[[1]])[, allele := ALLELES[cluster]],
       stats  = as.data.table(s[[2]])[, allele := ALLELES[cluster]],
       samples = as.data.table(reads)[, .(n_reads = .N), by = .(sample_name, allele = allele_group)])
})

alleles <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(per_gene), function(i) {
  st <- per_gene[[i]]$stats
  data.table(gene_name = genes$gene_name[i], group = genes$group[i], allele = st$allele,
             n_acf_valid = st$n_reads, mean_m6a_call_fraction = st$mean_m6a_call_fraction,
             peak_lag_bp = as.numeric(st$positive_local_peak_140_250_bp), peak_acf = st$peak_acf)
}))
alleles <- merge(alleles, genes[, .(gene_name, pooled_peak_lag_bp = peak_lag_bp,
                                    pooled_peak_acf = peak_acf)], by = "gene_name", sort = FALSE)
curves <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(per_gene), function(i)
  cbind(genes[i, .(group, gene_name)], per_gene[[i]]$curves[, .(allele, lag_bp, mean_acf, sem_acf, n_reads)])))
fwrite(alleles, file.path(out, "tables", "genes_by_allele.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(curves, file.path(out, "tables", "acf_per_gene_allele.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(per_gene), function(i)
  cbind(gene_name = genes$gene_name[i], per_gene[[i]]$samples))),
  file.path(out, "tables", "reads_by_sample_allele.tsv"), sep = "\t")

dcast(alleles, group + gene_name + pooled_peak_lag_bp ~ allele,
      value.var = c("n_acf_valid", "peak_lag_bp", "peak_acf", "mean_m6a_call_fraction"))[
  order(match(group, GROUPS))]
```

```{r group-curves}
#' Per-gene mean ACF of one allele, one row per gene in genes order.
gene_matrix <- function(a)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(per_gene, function(r) r$curves[allele == a]$mean_acf))

# group mean curves, genes weighted equally, by the parent summarize()
by_allele <- setNames(lapply(ALLELES, function(a) {
  rec <- data.frame(region_id = paste("example_genes", a), RID = genes$gene_name, sample_name = "all",
                    m6a_call_fraction = alleles[allele == a][match(genes$gene_name, gene_name),
                                                             mean_m6a_call_fraction],
                    cluster = match(genes$group, GROUPS), status = "clustered")
  s <- summarize(gene_matrix(a), rec)
  list(curves = as.data.table(s[[1]])[, `:=`(allele = a, group = GROUPS[cluster])],
       peaks  = as.data.table(s[[2]])[, `:=`(allele = a, group = GROUPS[cluster])])
}), ALLELES)
fwrite(rbindlist(lapply(by_allele, `[[`, "curves")),
       file.path(out, "tables", "acf_by_group_allele.tsv"), sep = "\t")

rbindlist(lapply(by_allele, `[[`, "peaks"))[, .(allele, group, genes = n_reads,
  peak_lag_bp = positive_local_peak_140_250_bp, peak_acf = signif(peak_acf, 3))]
```

# Figures

The same two figures as the pooled run, drawn once from the REF reads and once from the
ALT reads, written as PDFs to ``r file.path(out, "plots")``.

## 1. Mean ACF per group

```{r fig-group-mean, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
for (a in ALLELES) {
  region_data <- list(
    region = list(region_id = sprintf("TSS +50 to +2500 bp, %s reads at each gene's focal SNP, 5 genes per group, genes weighted equally", a),
                  focal_snp = "groups", ref = "C1 non-paused high, C2 paused high",
                  alt = "C3 paused moderate"),
    tables = list(cluster_acf_summary = as.data.frame(by_allele[[a]]$curves)))
  p <- plot_report_cluster_acf(region_data, lower = min(lags), upper = max(lags),
                               title = sprintf("Mean ACF per group, %s allele; no smoothing", a))
  save_figure(p, file.path(out, "plots", sprintf("01_group_mean_acf_%s.pdf", a)), width = 9, height = 7)
  print(p)
}
```

## 2. Per-gene mean ACF

```{r fig-per-gene, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
for (a in ALLELES) {
  d <- curves[allele == a & lag_bp %in% lags][, group := factor(group, levels = GROUPS)]
  m <- by_allele[[a]]$curves[lag_bp %in% lags][, group := factor(group, levels = GROUPS)]
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(lag_bp, mean_acf)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = .3) +
    geom_line(aes(colour = gene_name), linewidth = .3) +
    geom_line(data = m, colour = "black", linewidth = .6) +
    facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1) +
    labs(x = "Lag (bp)", y = "Mean ACF", colour = "Gene",
         title = sprintf("Per-gene mean m6A ACF, %s allele, TSS +50 to +2500 bp; black = group mean; no smoothing", a)) +
    theme_fiberseq("bw")
  save_figure(p, file.path(out, "plots", sprintf("02_per_gene_acf_%s.pdf", a)), width = 9, height = 8)
  print(p)
}
```

# Tests

The pooled run's tests, repeated within each allele, gene = unit: the squared difference of
the two group mean curves summed over lags `r min(lags)`-`r max(lags)` with an exact
permutation over all 252 splits of the 10 genes, and Wilcoxon rank-sum tests on per-gene
peak height, peak lag and m6A call fraction.

```{r tests}
COMPARISONS <- list(GROUPS[1:2], GROUPS[2:3])
profile_stat <- function(in_a, m)
  sum((colMeans(m[in_a, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(m[!in_a, , drop = FALSE]))^2)

tests <- rbindlist(lapply(ALLELES, function(a) {
  m_all <- gene_matrix(a)[, lags + 1L, drop = FALSE]
  tab   <- alleles[allele == a][match(genes$gene_name, gene_name)]
  rbindlist(lapply(COMPARISONS, function(cmp) {
    rows <- which(genes$group %in% cmp)
    in_a <- genes$group[rows] == cmp[1]
    m    <- m_all[rows, , drop = FALSE]
    obs  <- profile_stat(in_a, m)
    null <- apply(combn(length(rows), sum(in_a)), 2, function(k) profile_stat(seq_along(rows) %in% k, m))
    wil  <- function(col) {
      x <- tab[rows][[col]]
      x_a <- x[in_a][is.finite(x[in_a])];  x_b <- x[!in_a][is.finite(x[!in_a])]
      list(median_a = median(x_a), median_b = median(x_b),
           p = if (length(x_a) >= 2 && length(x_b) >= 2) wilcox.test(x_a, x_b, exact = TRUE)$p.value else NA_real_)
    }
    rbind(data.table(allele = a, a = cmp[1], b = cmp[2],
                     statistic = sprintf("profile SSD, lags %d-%d", min(lags), max(lags)),
                     value_a = NA_real_, value_b = NA_real_, observed = obs,
                     p_value = mean(null >= obs - 1e-12), n_permutations = length(null)),
          rbindlist(lapply(c("peak_acf", "peak_lag_bp", "mean_m6a_call_fraction"), function(col) {
            w <- wil(col)
            data.table(allele = a, a = cmp[1], b = cmp[2], statistic = paste("median", col),
                       value_a = w$median_a, value_b = w$median_b, observed = NA_real_,
                       p_value = w$p, n_permutations = NA_integer_)
          })))
  }))
}))
fwrite(tests, file.path(out, "tables", "tests_by_allele.tsv"), sep = "\t")
tests[, .(allele, a, b, statistic, value_a = signif(value_a, 3), value_b = signif(value_b, 3),
          observed = signif(observed, 3), p_value = signif(p_value, 3))]
```
